premises.text: Customers struggle to book last-minute personal services while qualified local merchants have idle capacity they want to monetize
premises.evidence_span: It seemed really inefficient that I had to go through the painful process of dialing all of those merchants just to find one that was willing to take my money, yet there's a pool of highly qualified small businesses that are willing to bend over backwards

premises.text: Bidzee lets customers place a named-price service request with terms (time, travel, rating) that is broadcast to local merchants who can accept, charge the card, and schedule
premises.evidence_span: Within a few clicks on a website or mobile apps, you can easily place a request for personal service, and you can even name your own price

premises.text: Merchants get customer acquisition with no upfront investment, bottom-of-funnel carded demand, certainty of timing, and the ability to accept only when they have excess capacity
premises.evidence_span: A merchant working with BidZ faces no upfront investment at all. They have bottom-of-the-funnel customers who have already put a credit card behind their offer

premises.text: Unlike C2C task marketplaces, Bidzee connects customers only to verified, rated local businesses
premises.evidence_span: BidZ is only connecting you with a verified, rated local business in order to perform the service

value.text: Customers get services on their terms while merchants monetize idle time with paying customers
value.evidence_span: A customer gets an appointment on their terms, and a business gets a paying customer through the door, allowing them to monetize, otherwise, idle time

causal_links.evidence_span: marketplaces can effectively solve these inefficiencies
we are the only platform that flips the equation and allows a customer to offer themselves to a business
bidsy merchants only need to accept bids when they know they have excess capacity
we're starting off with the key facet to a successful marketplace, trust

notes: Customer dialing pain and merchant idle-capacity willingness folded as one two-sided inefficiency (§4.1.6). Haircut/nails/dog walking/etc. treated as service categories of one bid marketplace, not separate premises. Merchant channel complaints (expensive/complicated/risky/no control) folded into merchant-on-their-terms acquisition premise. Groupon revenue treated as market evidence framing. Four-domain partition; not a need/product/money triad.
